events.description: A large-scale, chaotic physical brawl involving multiple individuals in a narrow indoor market or shop space; participants are seen punching, grappling, wielding poles and other objects, and overturning furniture (e.g., a cabinet at f8–f10).

Collective violent unrest: a dense group of people engaged in coordinated aggressive actions—including weapon use (poles), destruction of property (overturned cabinet, broken fixtures), and mass confrontation—within a confined commercial setting, exceeding isolated fighting.

A chaotic multi-person brawl in a narrow indoor market/stall setting, involving at least 6–8 individuals; participants use fists, improvised weapons (e.g., metal poles, wooden furniture), and grapple while moving through tight space; the fight escalates from pushing and shoving to weapon use and acrobatic maneuvers (e.g., jumping onto counters, swinging from overhead fixtures).

The fighting occurs within a larger context of collective violent unrest: multiple groups clash simultaneously in a confined public space (market stall), with bystanders reacting violently or joining; objects are hurled, furniture overturned, and the environment is destabilized (e.g., hanging lanterns swinging, shelves dislodged), indicating loss of order beyond a simple pairwise fight.

A chaotic multi-person melee fight in a dimly lit indoor market or workshop setting, involving at least 6–8 individuals wielding sticks, knives, and other improvised weapons; participants are actively striking, blocking, and grappling throughout the sequence.

After being knocked down onto styrofoam blocks (f12), a man in a brown shirt is repeatedly struck while on the ground by multiple attackers, including one in yellow who swings a weapon overhead (f13–f15), indicating targeted assault on a helpless victim.
A man is forcibly submerged and held underwater in a metal grate-filled pit by multiple assailants; he struggles while being pinned down and doused with water.

A bald man in a plaid shirt actively attacks the submerged victim using a long white object (possibly a pipe or baton), striking downward through the grate while others assist in restraining the victim.
A street-level fight occurs among multiple men: one in a yellow vest recoils as another in blue swings an arm aggressively; a third holds a stick-like object, indicating mutual physical combat.

A group of men, including a bald man in a plaid shirt, are gathered around a metal grate, wielding large knives and pressing down on something beneath the grate—suggesting coordinated physical aggression against a trapped or subdued target.

Multiple individuals engage in close-quarters combat in a crowded outdoor night setting; one man in a yellow vest is struck, another in blue swings a weapon, and chaotic melee ensues with visible strikes and grappling.
A man in a grey shirt violently attacks a restrained victim on the ground, repeatedly striking and choking him while a crowd watches; the victim is clearly helpless and being assaulted.
Initial physical confrontation between two men (one in grey shirt, one in dark jacket) with aggressive grappling and pushing before the victim is subdued and becomes helpless.
A group of men are engaged in a physical fight in a market stall area; one man in a black tank top holds a long blade-like object while others grapple and swing objects.

A large, agitated crowd gathers tightly in a narrow market alleyway, with visible tension and movement suggesting collective unrest; some individuals hold weapons (e.g., a knife visible in f12–f14), and the subtitle at f15 indicates an escalating verbal confrontation demanding release of someone.
